title: LADA Turbo Kings vs SEA Otters, Nov 15
notes: Home game at Renton: we wore white and had the right bench; SEA Otters wore dark green with red-white-red stripes (one skater in a yellow jersey with a blue front; their goalie in a blue #33 jersey). Renton's camera rolled about 1 degree since Nov 8; the Nov 8 rink geometry and ice-map calibration still fit once turned and shifted. The recording has sound.

Periods, goals and penalties come from the arena scoreboard (LADA TK were HOME), the game sheet and the video. Goals at 3:37, 33:47, 37:58, 49:48 and 54:31 of the video, each checked by eye, matching the sheet's 14:17 of the 1st, 4:38 and 0:24 of the 2nd, and 10:40 and 7:13 of the 3rd. Shots on goal from the game sheet: LADA TK 30, SEA Otters 35 (6-17 in the 1st).

Our goal: Podkorytov #82 (from Shakhov #78) jammed at the post as their goalie went down, and the puck went in from the scramble 4 s later. His track was lost in the scramble; the solver had Akulov #37 on in his place, fixed by eye.

Penalty kills, both in the 3rd: Kondratenko #12 tripping at 3:53 (58:19 to 61:53 of the video), then Sokolov #4 interference at 1:57 (61:22 to the final horn), 31 s of 5 on 3. Neither was scored on: an apparent SEA Otters goal at about 62:00 was waved off (the board went 4 to 5 and back).

Absent: Belousenko #13, Radutskiy #14, Babkin #26, Nizamutdinov #33, Unuchek #49, Belov #64, Bronnikov #74 and the sub Kleiman #69. Subs: Bogdanov #10 and Akulov #37, both new. Ivanov #90 arrived late: his first shift started about 12 minutes into the 1st.

Lineups checked by eye where the solver had the wrong count, a lost scorer or a long shift: 20 on/off spans, none labeled by hand. A 16 s window in the 2nd (28:39-28:55) stays at 4 on: a slow line change during a stoppage. SEA Otters' #37 (WALLY) in green passed our jersey test and got mixed into Akulov's labels; the reviewers were told apart by jersey colour.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 14:17: Pfeifer jams it in at Fisenko's post in a crease scramble, 0-1
2nd period, clock 4:38: Hexemer jams it in from the left post, 0-2
2nd period, clock 0:24: Porcincula drives across the crease and in past our sprawled goalie, 0-3
3rd period, clock 10:40: Podkorytov scores from a crease scramble over the downed goalie, Shakhov assisting, 1-3
3rd period, clock 7:13: Gonzalez dekes around a defender and scores, 1-4
